- 2 breaded fried chicken pieces (a drumette or wing): about 40 g and 45 g, around 85 g total, roughly 250 kcal.
- 1 plain wing, roasted: about 25 g, roughly 70 kcal.
- 2 breadsticks or crispy sticks: about 15 g total, roughly 60 kcal.

That comes to about 185 g of food and about 460 kcal. The chicken pieces look small, so I lowered the estimate to about 410 kcal.
